# Template length bound

**Claim.** For a finite-tape Turing machine $M$ and any template $\theta$, the length of the micro-operation list generated by $\theta$ is at most the maximum of these lengths over all templates for $M$.

**Proof.** The templates form a finite type, and $\theta$ belongs to the set of all templates. By the defining property of a supremum over a finite set, each value in that set is at most its supremum. Applying this to the function that assigns to each template the length of its generated micro-operation list gives the claimed bound.
